archimate:Capability.name: Care Transition Coordination
archimate:Capability.documentation: Care Transition Coordination: Standardized discharge, referral, and transfer protocols. Creation and exchange of structured transition documentation (e.g., discharge summary, referral note). Task assignment for follow-up actions (appointments, medication reconciliation). Communication channel for clarifications between sending and receiving providers. Patient and caregiver empowerment (education, follow-up reminders, self-monitoring tools).
